metadata.title: Elite-A combat and ship blueprint data
metadata.edition: released Elite-A fixed S.A–S.W blueprint files

combatNotes.constrictor: player laser hit strength is halved again before defence
combatNotes.stationImmunity: player lasers do not reduce station energy
combatNotes.npcOutgoingDamageToPlayerClean: (laserPower << 2) before player per-hit armour; missile count does not alter laser damage
combatNotes.npcOutgoingDamageToPlayerOriginal: if laserPower > 0, weaponByte >> 1 before player armour; this lets missile-count bits alter laser damage
combatNotes.cleanDestructionRule: destroy at currentEnergy <= 0; the original exact-zero survival quirk is intentionally omitted
combatNotes.regeneration: ordinary AI NPC ships regenerate; use elapsed time rather than render frames in a 60 fps recreation
